Your information

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 12, 2026

CalSwipes is developed by Ashkon Chaghajerdi and Dylan Brown. This policy describes how the current version of CalSwipes handles your information.

Information stored on your iPhone

The following information is stored locally on your iPhone and is never sent to CalSwipes servers:

  • Optional first name or nickname
  • Height and starting weight
  • Fitness goal (lose, maintain, or gain weight), activity level, and weekly rate
  • Optional target weight
  • Dietary restrictions, including allergens and preferences such as vegan, vegetarian, halal, and kosher
  • Logged meals, including food names, calories, protein, carbs, fat, dining hall, date, and time
  • Weight log entries
  • Recurring foods
  • Meal plans

Menu requests

CalSwipes fetches Berkeley Dining menu data from a backend server. The only information sent in these requests is the dining hall, date, and meal period. No personal information is included in these requests.

AI assistant and tray scans

CalSwipes includes an optional AI assistant. Many answers are produced on your iPhone, either from the menu already downloaded to the app or, on supported iPhones, with Apple's on-device model. These answers are not sent anywhere.

Some questions, and every tray photo you choose to scan, need the cloud assistant. The first time this happens, CalSwipes asks for your permission. If you allow it, the following is sent to the CalSwipes server, hosted on Google Cloud, and processed by Google's Gemini AI to produce an answer:

  • Your question text, or the tray photo you took or selected
  • The dining hall, meal period, and date you selected
  • If you tap “Ask about this meal,” the food names and nutrition values of that meal

Your profile, goals, weight, logged meals, dietary restrictions, and location are not sent.

To enforce daily limits, the server keeps a random app identifier created on your device (not linked to your name or Apple ID) and your network IP address, together with a count of AI requests per day. Tray photos are used only to answer the request and are not saved. Answers to common questions may be cached for up to 24 hours so they can be reused; the cache does not store who asked.

Google processes this data on behalf of CalSwipes under Google Cloud's terms. If you choose “Not now,” nothing is sent and the quick buttons keep working.

Location

CalSwipes requests Apple's “When In Use” location permission. Your location is used only on-device to determine which Berkeley dining hall you are nearest to.

Your location is not stored, sent to a server, or shared with third parties.

Camera

CalSwipes requests camera access so you can scan packaged-food nutrition labels and, if you choose, your dining hall tray.

Nutrition-label photos are processed entirely on-device using Apple's Vision framework and are not uploaded, stored, or shared.

If you use Scan meal to photograph your tray, that photo is sent to the cloud assistant as described in “AI assistant and tray scans” above.

What CalSwipes does not do

The current version of CalSwipes:

  • Does not require user accounts or sign-in
  • Does not collect email addresses
  • Does not use analytics or crash-reporting SDKs
  • Does not contain advertising or use advertising tracking
  • Does not use HealthKit
  • Does not contain payments or subscriptions
  • Does not share user data with third parties, except sending AI assistant requests you approve to Google as described above
  • Does not sell user data

Deleting your data

Because CalSwipes does not create user accounts and user information is stored locally on the device, users can delete their locally stored CalSwipes data by deleting the CalSwipes app from their iPhone. To ask us to delete the daily AI usage counts tied to your app identifier, email us.

Children's privacy

CalSwipes is not directed at children under 13.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The “Last updated” date will be changed when material updates are made.

Contact

For privacy questions, email support.calswipes@gmail.com.
